translationRepairs: Book of Sui, 52th year of Volume, 17th year of Biographies.
s0001 reads 隋書卷五十二列傳第十七; 卷 marks the volume and 列傳第十七 the biography section number, so “year of Volume/Biographies” is a clear mistranslation and the proposed wording matches the Chinese.
Han Qinhu, whose courtesy name was Zitong, came from Donyuan in Henan; his family later moved to Xin'an.
Han Qinhu, whose courtesy name was Zitong, came from Dongyuan in Henan; his family later moved to Xin'an.
s0003 has 河南東垣人; 東垣 romanizes as Dongyuan, so idiomatic “Donyuan” is a spelling error and the proposed Dongyuan is correct.
Han Qinhu, courtesy name Zitong, was a native of Donyuan in Henan; later his family settled in Xin'an.
Han Qinhu, courtesy name Zitong, was a native of Dongyuan in Henan; later his family settled in Xin'an.
The same 東垣 in s0003 requires Dongyuan in the literal field; “Donyuan” is simply the wrong romanization.
When Chen troops pressed Guangzhou, Qinhu, serving as Campaign Commander, routed them.
When Chen troops pressed Guang Prefecture, Qinhu, serving as Campaign Commander, routed them.

s0011 has 光州, the prefecture Guang, not 廣州 the city usually meant by bare “Guangzhou.” The proposed parenthetical still reuses that ambiguous city form; naming the place Guang Prefecture alone fixes the identity without inviting the 廣州 reading.
